risk_note: F1-07edb. apps/admin only (pages/orders, texts/orders.ts). Orders list: default 8 columns + actions, row 查看 drawer with deep link, a sync status bar that reads the latest order-sync once on load and on a manual 刷新 only (latest answer wins), shows 更新于 HH:mm:ss (Beijing, 24-hour) and stays on the read-time record after a submit; two F1-07ed S2 fixes (overflow page, URL year < 100). 12 frozen blocks changed as rule_change under BR-ID-46 with the reverse check. No contract, money or db change.

reviews.note: Codex money r1–r3 fail (S1s all on when the sync bar re-reads), BR-ID-46 amended (read-time record, 更新于, manual refresh; D10-2970 ② / D10-2973), implementation r6 (approvals 199); r4 full review against main pass with one S2 (dev StrictMode double first read) recorded as FU-F107EDB-SYNCBAR-STRICTMODE-DOUBLE-READ. couli-runs/F1-07edb/review-money-r4.json

spec_test_review.note: rule tests by Codex (ledger tester codex), 3 rounds (round 3 = approvals 199 increment); spec-test reviews by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, approvals 19 / 36): r1 fail (4 S1) → r2 pass → r3 incremental fail with 1 S1 (the 更新于 samples are all before 12:00 Beijing, so a 12-hour clock passes); orchestrator ruling D10-3100: no further review round, made an implementation must-hold item (24-hour clock, unit tests pin 14:30:00 and a midnight crossing 00:05:06) with FU-F107EDB-UPDATED-AT-24H before launch

longrun.note: PROP_RUNS=1000000 PROP_SEED=20261001; packages/money and test/properties are unchanged from main
